record.body:
## Rationale

Verification tasks take 20 to 80 minutes because each one runs the phase's checks and then the full suite, and often runs that suite again after a failure. The full non-tmux suite is about 4 minutes and growing, the tmux leg is about 90 seconds, and one acceptance that runs the whole dashboard app file took 506 seconds. The adopted choice is that verification runs the phase's integration check and the tests that phase names. Task-close instructions run that command only. The user accepted that a regression outside those tests has no automatic run.

## Counter-argument

One sped-up full suite would still catch a pilot that a later phase breaks. A single pass was already about 6 minutes, there is no CI, and that pass is the only regression net the loop has.

payload.alternatives: One full suite with repeats removed; one full suite sped up to fit the 10 minute budget
payload.choice: Verification runs the phase integration check and the tests that phase names. Task close does not add the full suite.

record.subject: phase-checks-only
